text_en: Then the Ephraimites said to him, “What have you done to us, not to call us when you went to fight against the Midianites? ” And they upbraided him violently.
text_cn: 那时厄弗辣因人对基德红说：“你去攻打米德杨时，没有召叫我们，你为什么这样对待我们？”他们激烈地与他争吵。

text_en: So he said to them, “What have I done now in comparison with you? Is not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer?
text_cn: 他回答他们说：“我所行的怎能比得上你们呢？厄弗辣因所拾的不比阿彼厄则尔所收的葡萄更好吗？

text_en: God has given into your hands the captains of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb; what have I been able to do in comparison with you? ” When he said this, their anger against him subsided.
text_cn: 天主将米德杨的首领敖勒布和则厄布交在你们手中，我所能行的怎能与你们相比？”为了他这番话，他们对他的怒气，就平息了。

text_en: Then Gideon came to the Jordan and crossed over, he and the three hundred who were with him, exhausted and famished.
text_cn: 基德红来到约但河，就渡过河；他与跟随他的三百人，虽然都疲倦，仍继续追赶。

text_en: So he said to the people of Succoth, “Please give some loaves of bread to my followers, for they are exhausted, and I am pursuing Zebah and Zalmunna, the kings of Midian. ”
text_cn: 他向稣苛特人说：“请你们给跟随我的人几个饼吃，因为他们疲倦了，我还愿去追赶米德杨的两个王子则巴黑和匝耳慕纳。”

text_en: But the officials of Succoth said, “Do you already have in your possession the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna, that we should give bread to your army? ”
text_cn: 稣苛特人的头目回答说：“难道则巴黑和匝耳慕纳的手已在你的掌握中，我们就该把饼送给你的军队吗？”

text_en: Gideon replied, “Well then, when the Lord has given Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand, I will trample your flesh on the thorns of the wilderness and on briers. ”
text_cn: 基德红说：“好吧！几时上主把则巴黑和匝耳慕纳交在我手中，我必要用茨条和荆棘鞭挞你们的身体。”

text_en: From there he went up to Penuel, and made the same request of them; and the people of Penuel answered him as the people of Succoth had answered.
text_cn: 以后由那里上去，到了培奴耳，也向他们说了同样的话；培奴耳人回答他也像稣苛特人一样。

text_en: So he said to the people of Penuel, “When I come back victorious, I will break down this tower. ”
text_cn: 他也对培奴耳人说：“当我平安回来时，我必拆毁这座碉堡。”

text_en: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor with their army, about fifteen thousand men, all who were left of all the army of the people of the east; for one hundred twenty thousand men bearing arms had fallen.
text_cn: 那时则巴黑和匝耳慕纳正在卡尔科尔，他们的军队约有一万五千人，这是全部东方子民所剩下的军队，因为已有十二万持刀的被击毙了。

text_en: So Gideon went up by the caravan route east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and attacked the army; for the army was off its guard.
text_cn: 基德红从诺巴黑和约革波哈东面，顺着住帐棚人的路上去，当敌人自以为安全的时候，袭击了军营，

text_en: Zebah and Zalmunna fled; and he pursued them and took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and threw all the army into a panic.
text_cn: 则巴黑和匝耳慕纳落荒而逃，基德红在后面追赶，捉住了那两个米德杨王子则巴黑和匝耳慕纳，并使全军覆没。

text_en: When Gideon son of Joash returned from the battle by the ascent of Heres,
text_cn: 约阿士的儿子基德红，从战场沿赫勒斯斜坡回来，

text_en: he caught a young man, one of the people of Succoth, and questioned him; and he listed for him the officials and elders of Succoth, seventy-seven people.
text_cn: 捉住了稣苛特的少年人，查问他。这少年人就给他写下稣苛特的首领和长老的名字，共七十七人。

text_en: Then he came to the people of Succoth, and said, “Here are Zebah and Zalmunna, about whom you taunted me, saying, ‘Do you already have in your possession the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna, that we should give bread to your troops who are exhausted? ’”
text_cn: 基德红遂往稣苛特人那里去说：“看！这是则巴黑和匝耳慕纳，你们为了他们曾讥笑我说：难道则巴黑和匝耳慕纳的手已在你掌握中，我们就该把饼送给你疲倦的人吗？”

text_en: So he took the elders of the city and he took thorns of the wilderness and briers and with them he trampled the people of Succoth.
text_cn: 他于是捉住那城的长老，用旷野里的茨条和荆棘惩罚了稣苛特居民。

text_en: He also broke down the tower of Penuel, and killed the men of the city.
text_cn: 以后又把培奴耳的碉堡拆毁，杀戮了城内的居民。

text_en: Then he said to Zebah and Zalmunna, “What about the men whom you killed at Tabor? ” They answered, “As you are, so were they, every one of them; they resembled the sons of a king. ”
text_cn: 然后询问则巴黑和匝耳慕纳说：“你们在大博尔山上杀戮的那些人是怎样的人呢？”他们答说：“他们像你们一样，个个都像君王的儿子。”

text_en: And he replied, “They were my brothers, the sons of my mother; as the Lord lives, if you had saved them alive, I would not kill you. ”
text_cn: 基德红说：“他们是我的兄弟，是我母亲的儿子：上主永在：如果你们保留了他们不死，我也就不杀你们。”

text_en: So he said to Jether his firstborn, “Go kill them! ” But the boy did not draw his sword, for he was afraid, because he was still a boy.
text_cn: 他遂对自己的长子耶特尔说：“起来，杀死他们！”但是这孩童害怕，拔不出刀来，因为年纪还小。

text_en: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, “You come and kill us; for as the man is, so is his strength. ” So Gideon proceeded to kill Zebah and Zalmunna; and he took the crescents that were on the necks of their camels.
text_cn: 因此，则巴黑和匝耳慕纳说：“你亲自起来杀死我们吧！因为人怎样，他的力量也怎样。”基德红就起来杀了则巴黑和匝耳慕纳，拿去他们骆驼颈上的月牙环。

text_en: Then the Israelites said to Gideon, “Rule over us, you and your son and your grandson also; for you have delivered us out of the hand of Midian. ”
text_cn: 事后，以色列人便对基德红说：“你既然从米德杨手中拯救了我们，请你和你的子孙作我们的君王！”

text_en: Gideon said to them, “I will not rule over you, and my son will not rule over you; the Lord will rule over you. ”
text_cn: 基德红回答他们说：“我不作你们的君王，我的子孙也不作你们的君王，唯有上主是你们的君王。”

text_en: Then Gideon said to them, “Let me make a request of you; each of you give me an earring he has taken as booty. ” (For the enemy had golden earrings, because they were Ishmaelites. )
text_cn: 基德红又向他们说：“我只向你们要求一件事：请将每人掠夺的金环给我。”原来依市玛耳人都有金环。

text_en: “We will willingly give them, ” they answered. So they spread a garment, and each threw into it an earring he had taken as booty.
text_cn: 他们答说：“我们情愿给你。”于是铺开一件外衣，每人把所掠夺的金环掷在上面。

text_en: The weight of the golden earrings that he requested was one thousand seven hundred shekels of gold (apart from the crescents and the pendants and the purple garments worn by the kings of Midian, and the collars that were on the necks of their camels).
text_cn: 他所要的金环共有一千七百“协刻耳”重；此外尚有月牙环，耳环和米德杨王所穿的紫红衣，及他们骆驼颈上的项链。

text_en: Gideon made an ephod of it and put it in his town, in Ophrah; and all Israel prostituted themselves to it there, and it became a snare to Gideon and to his family.
text_cn: 基德红用这些金子造了一个“厄弗得”，安置在他本城敖弗辣。以色列众人都到那里行邪淫，因此这个“厄弗得”便成了基德红及其家族的罗网。

text_en: So Midian was subdued before the Israelites, and they lifted up their heads no more. So the land had rest forty years in the days of Gideon.
text_cn: 米德杨在以色列子民前屈服，再没有抬起头来。基德红在世时，境内平安了四十年。

text_en: Jerubbaal son of Joash went to live in his own house.
text_cn: 约阿士的儿子耶鲁巴耳回去，安居在自己家中。

text_en: Now Gideon had seventy sons, his own offspring, for he had many wives.
text_cn: 基德红有七十个儿子，都是他亲生的，因为他有很多妻子。

text_en: His concubine who was in Shechem also bore him a son, and he named him Abimelech.
text_cn: 他在舍根的妾也给他生了一个儿子，给他起名叫阿彼默肋客。

text_en: Then Gideon son of Joash died at a good old age, and was buried in the tomb of his father Joash at Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
text_cn: 约阿士的儿子基德红寿终正寝，埋在阿彼厄则尔的敖弗辣，他父亲约阿士的坟墓里。

text_en: As soon as Gideon died, the Israelites relapsed and prostituted themselves with the Baals, making Baal-berith their god.
text_cn: 基德红死后，以色列子民又去跟从巴耳诸神行邪淫，立巴耳贝黎特当做他们的天主。

text_en: The Israelites did not remember the Lord their God, who had rescued them from the hand of all their enemies on every side;
text_cn: 以色列子民忘记了上主他们的天主，曾从四周所有的敌人手中救了他们，

text_en: and they did not exhibit loyalty to the house of Jerubbaal (that is, Gideon) in return for all the good that he had done to Israel.
text_cn: 也没有恩待耶鲁巴耳即基德红的家，以报答他施于以色列的恩惠。
